title: observability: token-level cost & latency alerts enhancements
author: Ava Patel
description: Add token-level cost and latency metrics for KV-cache-aware inference, improve dashboards, and tune alerting to reduce noise while preserving SLO coverage. This change introduces new Prometheus metrics (redwood_inference_tokens_total, redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket, redwood_token_cost_cents_total) emitted from the serving runtime with model, region, route, and cache_hit labels. Grafana dashboards are added/updated to show token-level P50/P95/P99 latency, per-model token cost breakdown, and KV cache hit/miss rates. Alert rules have been reworked: static threshold alerts for token-cost spikes were replaced with rate-of-change and anomaly-detector-based alerts, plus SLO-oriented burn-rate alerts for high-impact routes. We also add OpenTelemetry spans for token generation hotspots and a sampling policy to limit trace volume. Motivation: production teams were seeing noisy alerting and lacked a clear mapping from token counts to cost at route/model granularity. This PR reduces alert noise, surfaces root causes faster, and provides actionable dashboards for cost optimization and incident triage.
commits: feat(observability): emit redwood_inference_tokens_total and token-level histograms
feat(runtime): add token_cost_cents accounting and label propagation (model, route, region, cache_hit)
chore(grafana): add token-cost-latency and KV cache dashboards
fix(alerts): replace static cost spike alerts with burn-rate and rate-of-change rules
docs: add observability runbook and alert playbook updates
review_conversation: Riley Chen: Nice end-to-end — can you confirm the cardinality impact of adding model+route+region labels? We need an upper bound for Prometheus.

Ava Patel: Good call. Added a label cardinality table to docs/token-level-metrics.md and implemented a sampling/aggregation policy in instrumentation.go to emit per-route/model only for top-100 active models in last 24h (fallback aggregated 'other' label).
Miguel Santos: Alert rule change looks reasonable. Suggest lowering burn-rate sensitivity for free-tier routes so we don't page on trivial cost bursts.
Ava Patel: Adjusted alert scope and added tunable thresholds per customer_tier. Added unit tests for alert rule YAML parsing.
Priya Rao: Verified Grafana dashboard visualizations. One nit: add a legend for 'token_cost_cents_total / 1000' to make scale explicit.
Ava Patel: Updated dashboard JSON with explicit unit annotations and a note in the runbook. Requesting final approval.
Riley Chen: Approved. Miguel Santos: Approved. Priya Rao: Approved.

New Grafana dashboards: Token Cost & Latency, KV cache hit/miss, Per-model cost breakdown.
Alerting: replaced static cost spike alerts with burn-rate, rate-of-change, and anomaly-detection rules; added tier-aware thresholds to reduce noise.
Instrumentation: OpenTelemetry spans for token-generation hotspots and sampling policy to limit trace volume.
Docs: observability runbook and alert playbook updated with guidance on tuning thresholds and investigating cost regressions.
